scope: SIMULATED APP activation; hidden nonfocusable offscreen Electron. DOM/RAF only: physical screen presentation and native focus latency are not measured.

workload.source: Synthetic fixed-rate native intake; external WebSocket/network is not measured.

measurement.observer: One constant 1 Hz process-tree/frontmost sampler; no V8 or CDP profiles or renderer mutation observer.
measurement.resources: All Electron descendants and the main process including backend worker threads. CPU percent is one core; CPU energy is CPU-only, not total app/device/GPU/display energy.
measurement.coverage: Sampling can miss short-lived processes and transient focus changes. Source and sampler timestamps share the system epoch with small cross-process clock uncertainty.
measurement.latency: Date.now in main activation handler to its ready event after DOM commit and subsequent RAF; hidden renderer scheduling is not native display latency.

fixture.source: Synthetic native intake; external WebSocket transport and OKX network are not measured.

pooledDiagnostic.meaning: Pooled diagnostic only; use the separately conditioned summaries.

evidenceKind: Source-frozen controlled active/idle measurement, followed by explicitly identified delivery fixes; not a new Tauri comparison.

postMeasurementChanges.explanation: Post-measurement startup/test boundaries: nonblocking initial idle, native activation listener registration before backend readiness, and no native activation in an intentionally inactive background test bundle. Also retain deferred Gateway bytes on an encode/send failure. Warm steady-state workload and successful snapshot path are unchanged apart from an empty delivered-ID list; no Gateway response exists in the measured workload.
Explicit off launch option and postprocessing-only grouped live/quiescent latency summaries; source fixture, cadence, paired resource windows and individual captured latency samples are unchanged.

Recorded functional tests default to full tracing and retain the sandbox journal directory; explicitly off resource runs preserve their previous recording setting. Assert the requested capability and await initial document snapshot readiness before setup.
